$comment: 语法大厅 G06（V0.9 P1b）。锚点：每周固定的排练。全部内容原创。
title: 一般现在时与三单
ketNote: 三单 -s 是 KET 写作里老师第一眼扫的错；拼写变化（-es/-ies/has）在 Part 5 反复出现。八课里的亲戚是 L3。

sections.essence: 一般现在时说的不是「此刻」，是「一直如此」——像每周固定的排练。
sections.why: 这个时态的名字会骗人：「现在」两个字让人以为它管眼前这一刻，其实它管的是习惯和事实——「乐团每周六排练」，你半夜问也成立。中文表达习惯靠加词：「每天」「常常」，动词「练」从不变形。英语把「这是常态」刻进动词，还留了一个奇怪的记号：主语是第三人称单数（他、她、它、任何单个的人或物）时，动词要加 -s——She plays. 为什么偏偏是三单？一千年前英语每个人称都有专属词尾，如今磨得只剩这一个。它是幸存者，不是新发明。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团每周六下午三点排练——这句话什么时候说都成立：你早上说、深夜说、放假说，排练表就贴在那里。这就是一般现在时的地盘：习惯、事实、时间表，跟「此刻正在干什么」无关。排练表上每个人一行：I practise on Saturdays. You practise on Saturdays. 轮到写「她」那一行，笔要多勾一下：She practises on Saturdays.——那个 -s 像点名册上第三人称专属的小勾，提醒大家「这一行说的是别人，单独一个人」。勾错了行，考官一眼就看见；勾漏了，整张排练表都显得潦草。

cards.rule: 管什么：习惯、事实、时间表
cards.detail: 每周的排练、地球绕太阳、火车八点开——「一直如此」的事都归它。
cards.example: We practise every Saturday. / The train leaves at eight.

cards.rule: 三单加 -s：她他它，动词多勾一笔
cards.detail: 主语是 he / she / it 或任何单个的人和物，动词加 -s。
cards.example: She plays the flute. / My father works in a bank.

cards.detail: ch/sh/s/x/o 结尾加 -es（watches, goes）；辅音+y 变 -ies（studies）；have 直接换成 has。
cards.example: watch → watches / study → studies / have → has

cards.detail: I / you / we / they 和复数主语，动词一笔不多。
cards.example: I play. / They play. / My parents work hard.

cards.detail: always / usually / often / sometimes / never 贴在实义动词前面（be 动词则贴在后面）。
cards.example: He often drinks tea. / She is always late.

basic.en: I get up at seven every day.
She plays the flute very well.
basic.cn: 她长笛吹得很好。（本事，一直如此）

basic.en: We have a music class on Friday.
My father works in a hospital.

mid.en: The band practises every Saturday afternoon.
My sister studies English every morning.
mid.cn: 我妹妹每天早上学英语。（study → studies）

mid.en: The train leaves at eight, so don't be late.
mid.cn: 火车八点开，别迟到。（时间表）

mid.en: She never eats ice cream in winter.
mid.cn: 她冬天从不吃冰激凌。（never 站动词前）

trap.note: have 的三单不是 haves，直接换成 has。

trap.en: My mother goes to work by bus.
The baby often cries at night.
trap.note: 辅音+y 变 -ies：cry → cries；但 play 是元音+y，直接 plays。
everyone 看着是「大家」，语法上算单数——动词加 -s。

trap.en: My friend and I walk to school together.
trap.cn: 我和朋友一起走路上学。
trap.note: 两个人做主语=复数，动词用原形，别顺手加 -s。

trap.en: Look! It's raining. — But it rarely rains here.
trap.cn: 看，下雨了。——不过这里很少下雨。
trap.note: 「此刻在下」归现在进行时（G07）；「这里少雨」才归一般现在时——两块牌子别挂错。

redBlack.good: Look! He is playing the piano.
redBlack.why: 想说「他此刻正在弹」，却挂了「习惯」的牌子——听的人以为你在介绍他的爱好，不是眼前的事。

redBlack.bad: I am play basketball every Sunday.
redBlack.why: am 和 play 撞车：到底是「正在打」还是「每周打」？说习惯不需要 be，动词自己上。

redBlack.bad: He play the drum every day.
redBlack.good: He plays the drum every day.
redBlack.why: 三单主语，动词要多勾一笔 -s。
have 的三单是 has，不是 haves——整词替换。

redBlack.bad: My mother watchs TV at night.
redBlack.good: My mother watches TV at night.

redBlack.why: play 是元音+y，直接加 -s——别把 -ies 规则用过头。

redBlack.bad: My father go to work at eight.
redBlack.good: My father goes to work at eight.
redBlack.why: father 是三单，go 加 -es 变 goes。
-s 是三单专属的勾，I 用原形——多勾也是错。

redBlack.bad: The earth go around the sun.
redBlack.good: The earth goes around the sun.
redBlack.why: 事实也归一般现在时；earth 三单，goes。
often 该站在动词前——语序不顺但意思不丢，KET 也很少专考这个。
撇号丢了还用错了 do——意思能懂；否定句的完整规矩到 G12 细讲。

contrast.cn: 我每天练琴。（「练」永远不变）
contrast.en: I practise every day. / She practises every day.
contrast.diff: 中文靠「每天」表达习惯；英语除了时间词，动词还要按人称变形。

contrast.cn: 他喝茶。她喝茶。大家喝茶。（一个「喝」）
contrast.en: He drinks. / She drinks. / They drink.
contrast.diff: 中文动词从不看主语脸色；英语单看动词尾巴就知道主语是不是三单。

contrast.en: He is playing.（此刻） / He plays.（习惯）
contrast.diff: 中文加「正在/经常」；英语换整套动词形态——两块牌子两套衣服。
时间表上的事英语也用一般现在时——它管「安排好、一直如此」。

contrast.en: He has two cats.（have 变 has）
contrast.diff: 最常用的动词变形最彻底——has 不是加 -s，是整词换。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 说的是习惯或事实吗？主语是单独一个吗？是就给动词勾上 -s
steps: 先确认时态：这句说的是「一直如此」（习惯/事实/时间表）吗？眼前正在发生的不归它。
找主语：he / she / it 或任何单个的人和物 → 三单。
三单给动词加 -s；ch/sh/s/x/o 结尾加 -es；辅音+y 变 -ies；have 换 has。
I / you / we / they 和复数主语 → 原形，一笔不多。
频度副词（always/often/never）放在动词前面。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语说习惯的时候，句子里藏着一个小规矩：说『他』『她』或者某一个人的习惯，动词后面要多勾一笔 s——就像点名册上『别人』那一行要打个勾。咱们玩勾勾游戏：我说家里人的习惯，你告诉我要不要打勾——『爸爸每天七点上班』（要，爸爸是一个人）、『我们周末去公园』（不要，是我们）。」不用懂英语，判断「说的是不是单独的另一个人」就行。她答对了可以加码问：watch 这种词勾出来长什么样（watches）？have 呢（has，整个换掉）？
questions: 「我练琴」和「她练琴」——英语里两个「练」长得一样吗？
为什么「看！他正在弹琴」不能用每周排练那套说法？
have 的「勾」长什么样？和别的词有什么不一样？

sections.echo: 三单的 -s 是一座孤零零的纪念碑：一千年前，英语每个人称都有自己的动词词尾（我 -e、你 -est、他 -eth……），莎士比亚还在写 thou likest（你喜欢）、he liketh（他喜欢）。后来词尾一个个磨掉，唯独第三人称的这一个活了下来，-eth 还慢慢变成了今天的 -s。为什么偏偏它幸存？「他、她、它」是我们聊天时最常说到的对象——越常用的位置，越舍不得改。你今天多勾的这一笔，是古英语最后的遗产。

stages.name: 选一选 · 填进排练表

questions.q: My father ___ to work by bus.
She ___ English every morning.
Tom ___ two cats and a dog.
questions.explain: 三单的 have 是 has。

questions.q: I ___ up at seven every day.
questions.explain: I 用原形——多勾也是错。

questions.q: The train ___ at eight in the morning.
questions.explain: 时间表用一般现在时；train 三单——leaves。

questions.q: We ___ football after school.
My sister ___ TV on Sunday evenings.
He often ___ his room on weekends.
questions.explain: he 三单——cleans；often 站动词前。

questions.q: Lily ___ the flute very well.
questions.explain: 三单 plays；play 元音+y 不变 -ies。

questions.q: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.explain: 事实归一般现在时；sun 三单——rises。

questions.q: My parents ___ me with my maths.
She ___ her teeth twice a day.
Water ___ at 100 degrees.
He ___ his grandma every week.
Our band ___ every Saturday afternoon.
The baby ___ when it is hungry.
哪一句的动词是健康的？（他每天打鼓）
options: He plays the drum every day.
He play the drum every day.
He is play the drum every day.
questions.explain: 三单要 -s；说习惯不请 be。

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（她养兔子）
questions.explain: have 的三单整词换 has。

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（妈妈的工作）
options: My mother works in a hospital.
My mother work in a hospital.
My mother workes in a hospital.

questions.q: often 站哪里才健康？
questions.explain: 频度副词站在实义动词前。

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（我拉小提琴）
questions.explain: I 用原形；-s 是三单专属。

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（他和我们踢球）
哪一句的动词是健康的？（地球绕太阳）
options: The earth goes around the sun.
The earth go around the sun.
The earth going around the sun.
questions.explain: 事实用一般现在时；三单 goes。

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（她每天学英语）
哪一句的动词是健康的？（爸爸八点上班）
options: My father goes to work at eight.
My father go to work at eight.
My father gos to work at eight.

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（每周日打球）
options: I am play basketball every Sunday.
questions.explain: 习惯句不请 be——动词自己上。

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（宝宝夜里哭）
options: The baby often cries at night.
The baby often crys at night.
The baby often cry at night.

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（她从不迟到）
options: She is never late for school.
She never is late for school.
questions.explain: be 动词时频度副词站它后面：is never late。

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（叔叔修自行车）
哪一句的动词是健康的？（同学们喜欢她）
options: Her classmates like her very much.
Her classmates likes her very much.
Her classmates liking her very much.

questions.q: 哪一句的动词是健康的？（猫抓老鼠）
哪一句的动词是健康的？（老师每天说）
options: Our teacher says this every day.
Our teacher saies this every day.
Our teacher sayes this every day.

questions.q: The film ___ at 7:30, so we must arrive before that.
questions.explain: 时间表上的事——一般现在时三单 starts。

questions.q: Everyone in our class ___ music.
My friend and I ___ to school together.
One of the boys ___ the trumpet.
Every student ___ a dictionary in our class.
She ___ in the choir every Sunday.
questions.explain: every Sunday 是习惯的标志——常态牌 sings。

questions.q: My cat ___ fish but never ___ vegetables.
questions.explain: 同一个三单主语，两个动词都要勾 -s。

questions.q: — What time ___ the museum open? — It ___ at nine.
questions.explain: 问句请 does（预告 G12），答句里 it 三单 opens。

questions.q: Nobody ___ the answer to this question.
The children ___ up early, but their grandpa ___ up even earlier.
questions.explain: children 复数原形；grandpa 三单 gets。

questions.q: Our music teacher always ___ us interesting stories.
questions.explain: teacher 三单——tells；always 站动词前。

questions.q: It rarely ___ here in spring.
questions.explain: 气候是「一直如此」的事实——三单 rains。

questions.q: My grandma ___ flowers and ___ them every morning.
questions.explain: grandma 三单，两个动词都勾：grows、waters。

questions.q: The No. 3 bus ___ by our school every ten minutes.
questions.explain: 时刻表事实；s 结尾加 -es——passes。

questions.q: Each of the girls ___ a beautiful voice.
大考：My sister ___ the piano, and my parents ___ to listen.
questions.explain: sister 三单 plays；parents 复数原形 love——一句两查。

detective.clue: 三单主语 he，动词要勾上 -s。

detective.sentence: My mother haves a red bike.
detective.fixed: My mother has a red bike.
detective.clue: have 的三单不是 haves——整词换成 has。

detective.sentence: The sun rise in the east.
detective.fixed: The sun rises in the east.
detective.clue: 事实也归一般现在时；sun 是三单——rises。

detective.sentence: My father go to work at eight o'clock.
detective.fixed: My father goes to work at eight o'clock.
detective.clue: o 结尾的 go 三单加 -es——goes。

detective.sentence: Lily always sing in the morning.
detective.fixed: Lily always sings in the morning.
detective.clue: Lily 是三单，always 挡不住那个 -s——sings。
